description: Default local-network stack on the mainnet-deployed contract surface: the graph-contracts image deploys the protocol as it exists on mainnet (Phase 1/2 only — no REO / IssuanceAllocator / RecurringAgreementManager; Phase 3 skipped via GIP0088_ENABLED=0). Upstream stable image versions for all services; no rewards-eligibility or indexing-payments components. This is what `just up` gives a fresh checkout. Use the gip-0088 recipe for the post-audit GIP-0088 deployment.
